role: The client and server player ticks the lockstep replay drives: the client player's input, sprint, jump, water, ladder and ground movement and its C03/C0B motion packets, and the server player's C0B actions, processPlayer validation (S08 corrections) and EntityPlayerMP.onUpdateEntity movement, plus loading both players from the snapshot NBT trees.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 51, function key_lookup: strcmp over key descriptions (load/parse time)
line 243, function liquid_flow_vector: strcmp on the material name "ice" inside the tick
lines 394-396, function scalar_text: nbt_render heap string then free (snapshot load, not the tick)
line 1241, function client_player_tick: particles_live_tick on a shared surv_fx particle state (client-side cosmetic work inside the client tick)

struct client_player and server_player (player.h) hold function pointers on_world_change and on_entity_update and pointers to combat, replay, open_container and iew: a pointer graph between per-player state
notes: The Java member lists are read from the port's function comments and names; each Java member was not opened individually. Survival state, eating, sleep, stats and the s2c packet queue live in survival.c and sleep.c, which player.c calls (surv_client_tick_start, surv_server_tick_start, sleep_client_update and so on). play/play.c drives client_player_tick for the human client. The header comment lists what it does not port: dig and right-click use on these tapes, and the other entities. lane/clientstate: the client player carries EntityPlayerSP's portal timer (clientstate.c): cp_set_in_portal from its own move's portal cells, the tick in cp_on_living_update with the trigger draw on sv.erand; survival.c resets it for a fresh player. client_player_load / server_player_load read a snapshot's runtime block: the sprint and sneak flags, the movementSpeed value, the jump counters, the bounding box, the ridden vehicle, the portal counters, currentWindowId and the handler's lastPos. lane/anytick: both loads take the runtime collision flags (EntityPlayerSP stops a sprint on isCollidedHorizontally before it moves). lane/covclient: the tracker pass sends the player's own watcher 7 and 8 (potion colour and ambience) as PK_S1C_POT when they change.
